name: Force Load: choose a fire/norm 0-cost Bullet and load into target Gun
notes: Force Load reads the material zone directly, and this fixture's own deck's Material section has no Bullet cards, so a real 0-memory-cost NORM Bullet (Plated Bullet) is seeded there via test-setup. Shadow's Twin is seeded unloaded onto the field as the target Gun -- LoadBulletIntoGun() is the same shared function used by Plated Bullet's own [REST] ability (see plated-bullet-rest-load-shadows-twin-power), so loading via Force Load also triggers Shadow's Twin's 'whenever this becomes loaded, +2 POWER' trigger.

rulesClauses: Choose a fire or norm element Bullet card from your material deck with memory cost 0 and load it into target Gun weapon you control.
